purpose: Abstract base for all V2 dispatchers. Implements the template-method dispatch split: a non-virtual external dispatch() applies the full modifier chain (nonReentrant, onlyMinter, whenNotPaused), calls the concrete internal virtual _dispatch(), then unconditionally calls hook.onDispatch(). Holds metadata, minter authorization, pausability, and a pluggable (never-zero) dispatch hook.

verifiedProperties.pauseMechanism: OZ Pausable; pause/unpause restricted to _minter (the NFTMinterV2)

localFindings.description: dispatch() calls hook.onDispatch() AFTER _dispatch() within the same nonReentrant span. A malicious/buggy hook can revert the whole dispatch (and therefore the enclosing mint). hook is never zero (DefaultDispatchHook in ctor) and is owner-settable to non-zero only, so the branch-free invariant holds. Hook trust = owner trust. Concrete dispatchers MUST NOT re-declare onlyMinter/whenNotPaused/nonReentrant on their _dispatch override (verified: BurnerV2/GatherV2/BalancerPoolerV2 overrides are bare internal).
localFindings.recommendation: None (documented design). Interaction analysis should treat hook as owner-trusted code in the dispatch path.

localFindings.description: setMinter is onlyOwner with no zero-check and no event. Setting an incorrect minter breaks dispatch authorization (dispatch reverts) but is owner-recoverable. The minter address gates pause/unpause and dispatch; it is the core trust edge to NFTMinterV2.
localFindings.recommendation: Optional: emit an event and/or zero-check for operational clarity.

externalEntryPoints.function: dispatch(address minter, uint256 amount, bytes extraData)

externalCalls.notes: Invoked after every successful _dispatch; can revert dispatch.

valueFlows: No direct value flow in the abstract; concrete _dispatch overrides move the tokens. The abstract guarantees the funds-routing happens exactly once per dispatch under reentrancy/pause/minter guards, then notifies the hook with the same (minter, amount, extraData).
invariants: hook is never address(0) (constructor + setHook zero-check).
dispatch is only callable by _minter, only when not paused, and never reentrantly.
hook.onDispatch receives the identical (minter, amount, extraData) passed to dispatch.
Concrete _dispatch overrides carry no modifiers (modifiers live on the external dispatch).
trustAssumptions: Owner sets only trusted hooks; a hook revert is an owner-recoverable liveness issue (swap the hook).
Owner is trusted with metadata and minter wiring.
